metadata.description: The unique guid for this scheduled alert rule

properties.description: Detects creation of new Entra ID applications by looking for application add operations in AuditLogs and projects the entity that initiated the creation.
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where OperationName in~ ('Add application','Add service principal','Add application registration','Add application')
| where Result =~ 'success'
| extend Initiator = tostring(InitiatedBy)
| extend InitiatorUPN = tostring(parse_json(InitiatedBy).user.userPrincipalName)
| extend InitiatorDisplayName = tostring(parse_json(InitiatedBy).user.displayName)
| extend InitiatorApp = tostring(parse_json(InitiatedBy).app.displayName)
| extend InitiatorId = tostring(parse_json(InitiatedBy).user.id)
| extend InitiatorServicePrincipal = tostring(parse_json(InitiatedBy).app.servicePrincipalName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Result, ResultDescription, Category, LoggedByService, CorrelationId, InitiatorUPN, InitiatorDisplayName, InitiatorId, InitiatorApp, InitiatorServicePrincipal
